text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm out to meet up with
Matikanefukukitaru on
my day off,
when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
F-finally! It really happened! I got ten
"great
fortunes" in a row from my fortune
slip key chain!
choice_data_list_en: What's wrong?!
What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This racewear must be boosting my good
luck! No
doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! With all these four-leaf
clovers,
amulets, and good-luck charms,
this racewear is
packed with fortune!
choice_data_list_en: Is that the power of your racewear?
Is this the power of your racewear?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was going to give it a spin around town
to test
out its power, but I think it's
already good to go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to put this overwhelming
abundance of
luck to good use today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to put this overwhelming
abundance of
luck to good use today!
choice_data_list_en: How about helping people out?
How about helping people out?
Please, bring me good fortune!
Please, bring me good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's a great idea! Now to find
someone in
need of some help...
choice_data_list_en: How about helping people out?
How about helping people out?
Please, bring me good fortune!
Please, bring me good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Wh-what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I didn't think it'd be that easy!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Sob! Where did he go?! Lucky! Where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After asking the young girl a few
questions, we
learn that she accidentally
let go of her pet dog's
leash during their
walk.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With a name like Lucky, this can only be the work of fate!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Matikanefukukitaru is on the job!
I'll find
your little Lucky in no time!
choice_data_list: まさに貴方の出番だね
choice_data_list_en: This is truly your time to shine.
This is truly your time to shine.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You can count on it! Luck follows me
wherever I
go, so little Lucky should be
no different!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Dogs get along with other dogs, and I
just happen
to have a lion-dog charm in
my bag! You know,
like the statues you
see at all the shrines!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now to commence the divination! I'll just
put this
here, and... Woof, woof! Bow
wow! Shiba Inu,
Chow Chow!

text_block_list.name: Shiba Inu
text_block_list.text: Pitter, patter... Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyahhhhh! Hey, gimme back my
lion-dog!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A Shiba Inu suddenly runs up, snatches
up the
lion-dog charm, and scampers
off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Wait! That dog has a leash on it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What if that's Lucky?! Let's hurry and
find out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We give chase, following Lucky until he
plants
himself down just outside of a
shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If we get any closer, Lucky might
run into
the mall and cause a scene...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I have a spell that can project
my
thoughts telepathically, but I've
never tried it on
a dog before...
choice_data_list: 呼び寄せるオマジナイとかないのか？
呼び寄せるオマジナイとかないの？
choice_data_list_en: Isn't there a charm or something to call it over?
Isn't there a charm or something to call it over?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! All the luck in the
universe is with
me!
choice_data_list: 今の幸運パワーなら何でもできる！
choice_data_list_en: With my lucky power right now, anything is possible!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh! Doberoo, mastifoo, malamoo,
ho...
Labradoo, rottweiloo, spanieloo,
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't say if the telepathy worked, but
about ten
minutes later, Lucky walks
close enough for us to
grab hold of his
leash.

text_block_list.name: Lucky
text_block_list.text: Whine...

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Lucky! You're back! Thank you so much
for the
help!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome. Hehe, guess we were
quite lucky
in finding him, huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Really?! That's so cool!
choice_data_list: 幸運の神様みたいなウマ娘だからな
幸運の神様みたいなウマ娘だからね
choice_data_list_en: She's practically a goddess of good fortune, after all.
She's practically a goddess of good fortune, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... Heh, hehehe! I wouldn't go
that far...

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Praise be! Umm... Fukukitaru!
choice_data_list: フクキタル様、ありがたや～！
choice_data_list_en: Praise be to Lady Fukukitaru~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, if you ever need any more
help, leave
it to me and my super-lucky
powers to work
things out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I went a little too far with that
bit... How
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I was so happy hearing all
those
compliments. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'd say this outfit's lucky powers
are now
officially certified! It's definitely
coming with me
for my next race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You never know, maybe we'll meet that
girl there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What?! You want some of my power?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Even if you beg, I don't really
know...
choice_data_list: なにとぞ、なにとぞ幸運を！
choice_data_list_en: Please, oh please, grant us good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Now, how could I say no to
that?! Your
wish is my command!
choice_data_list: 神様仏様マチカネフクキタル様～！
choice_data_list_en: Oh Gods, oh Buddhas, oh Matikanefukukitaru-sama~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll just sprinkle a little bit of my
power on
this charm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nom, nom, hum, hum, doopee-dee!
There you go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This charm here is a special one. With
this, you'll
always end up with a
raffle-winning popsicle stick
after
finishing your icy treat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What an oddly specific power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...All the same, I take my newly imbued
charm for
a test-drive and buy myself a
popsicle.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You won! Congratulations! Hehe, looks
like my
charm's working just as
advertised, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Woo! Another winner!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And... another one?!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
There's no way we only have winners...
That would
be crazy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amid the confusion, a man wobbles into
the store
on the verge of collapse.

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: Please... give me... a popsicle...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... I'm sorry, but... we kinda just
bought all
of the popsicles...

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: You what?! Gyahhh! Thud.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eek! A-are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hurry, give him one of your
popsicles!

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I thought I was a goner. Please,
let me
repay your kindness...

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text:
In return for a popsicle... Yes, this will
do.

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this box. Thank you, and
farewell.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There he goes... What do you think is
inside?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, Trainer! What if this is a
trap?!
Like a Pandora's box situation!
choice_data_list: とりあえず開けてみるよ
choice_data_list_en: For now, I'll try opening it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No way! A shiny blue smartphone?! And
it's
unopened!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! I-it's the newest model too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me... The charm isn't limited to just popsicles, but anything that begins with the letter p, like "phone"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there is more to be done!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It only took one charm to get all this!
Just
imagine what would happen with
two charms, or
even three!
choice_data_list_en: Wh-What is?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is a huge chance for us! Let's get a
whole
boatload of charms for you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If you have this charm, you'll
never
misplace your loose change! And
this one helps
you split disposable
chopsticks perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, this is way too much trouble! Let's
just get
'em all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I trudge through town like some kind of

decorated officer, covered head-to-toe
in lucky
charms. I'm not quite sure what
my
accomplishments are, however.
